vetSays.line: 🛡️ Carmela, Kambale, Adaeze and Dale met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 driven off. Carmela, Kambale, Adaeze, Dale are hurt.
🛡️ Carmela, Kambale, David and Oliver met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off. Carmela, Kambale, David are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carmela just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Carmela, Kambale, Dale, Greta and Oliver met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Carmela, Kambale, Dale, Greta, Oliver are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carmela just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Adaeze just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Carmela, Adaeze, David, Greta and Oliver met them at the door — 5 put down. Carmela, Adaeze, David, Greta, Oliver are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Dale, Oliver and Boris met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Oliver, Boris are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nicolas just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Rafael and Nicolas met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Rafael, Nicolas are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rafael just put down The Algorithm... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Rafael met them at the door — 1 put down. Rafael is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rafael just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Rafael met them at the door — 1 put down.
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ugur just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Brigitte just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

🛡️ Brigitte met them at the door — 1 put down. Brigitte is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
